input.quote: After thirty consecutive days, Customer may terminate the affected Order Form without penalty and receive a refund of prepaid Fees for the unavailable period.
input.rationale: No provision imposes liquidated damages, a penalty, an early-termination fee, or a minimum termination payment on Customer. Searches for "liquidated damages", "penalty", early-termination fees, acceleration, forfeiture, non-refundable and minimum-fee mechanics returned nothing adverse: § 1.5 mentions service credits and damages only as exclusions from Fees, § 7.3 bars interest on amounts ultimately found not due, § 24.4 bars acceleration of Fees on Customer change of control, and § 27.3 expressly lets Customer terminate "without penalty". The only Customer-payable amounts elsewhere are undisputed Fees for conforming Services and an audit shortfall, which are not liquidated amounts. The take-or-pay commitment in § 2.1 is a minimum-volume exposure reviewed under the minimum-commitment rule and is not flagged again here. The Agreement therefore meets the preferred position that Customer pays no liquidated damages or penalties, so no redline is proposed.
